rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Contract Order of Precedence
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must accept that in any conflict among Contract documents, the State's terms and conditions prevail over the Contractor's Proposal, and the order of precedence is (1) Combined Standard Terms and Conditions, (2) Agency scope of work, (3) Contractor's Proposal.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on Influencing State Officers/Employees
rfp_requirements.description: No vendor shall influence or attempt to influence any State officer or employee or special State officer or employee in his/her official capacity in any manner that might impair the objectivity or independence of judgment.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on Securing Unwarranted Privileges
rfp_requirements.description: No vendor shall cause or attempt to cause any State officer or employee or special State officer or employee to use official position to secure unwarranted privileges or advantages for the vendor or any other person.

rfp_requirements.title: General Public Gift/Contract Exception
rfp_requirements.description: The prohibitions in paragraphs 2.10A through 2.10E shall not be construed to prohibit a State officer/employee from receiving gifts from or contracting with vendors under the same terms and conditions as are offered to members of the general public, subject to any State Ethics Commission guidelines

rfp_requirements.title: Accept New Jersey choice of law
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must accept that any contracts/orders resulting from this Proposal are governed and construed under the laws of the State of New Jersey.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Americans with Disabilities Act
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must comply with all provisions of the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA), P.L. 101-336, in accordance with 42 U.S.C. 12101, et seq.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay to Play Compliance with Chapter 51 and EO 333
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must comply with Pay to Play Prohibitions pursuant to P.L.2005, c.51, as amended by the Elections Transparency Act, P.L.2023, c.30 (N.J.S.A. 19:44A-20.13 to 20.25, 'Chapter 51') and Executive Order 333 (2023), which insulate the negotiation and award of State contracts from political cont

rfp_requirements.title: Refrain from Prohibited Political Contribution Activities
rfp_requirements.description: Business Entity shall not make or solicit prohibited contributions, conceal or misrepresent contributions, use intermediaries, condition contributions, engage lobbyists for contributions, fund third-party contributions, or otherwise circumvent the Legislation; doing so is a breach of contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with debarment/suspension regulations and flow down
rfp_requirements.description: Comply with 2 C.F.R. pt. 180, subpart C and 2 C.F.R. pt. 3000, subpart C, and include a requirement to comply with these regulations in any lower tier covered transaction.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain debarment/suspension compliance throughout contract and include in lower tier transactions
rfp_requirements.description: Comply with 2 C.F.R. pt. 180, subpart C and pt. 3000, subpart C throughout the offer validity and any resulting contract, and include a compliance provision in lower tier covered transactions.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on services provided by covered entities
rfp_requirements.description: Do not obtain telecommunications or video surveillance services provided by the covered entities or using such equipment.

rfp_requirements.title: Prohibition on equipment/services from foreign-government-controlled entities
rfp_requirements.description: Do not obtain telecommunications or video surveillance equipment or services produced or provided by an entity that the Secretary of Defense reasonably believes to be owned/controlled by or connected to the government of a covered foreign country.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with All Other Section 6002 Requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Comply with all other applicable requirements of Section 6002 of the Solid Waste Disposal Act.

rfp_requirements.title: Include Equal Opportunity Clause in Federally Assisted Construction Contracts
rfp_requirements.description: All contracts meeting the definition of federally assisted construction contract in 41 CFR Part 60-1.3 must include the equal opportunity clause provided under 41 CFR 60-1.4(b) in accordance with Executive Order 11246.

rfp_requirements.title: Applicant Bound by Equal Opportunity Clause for Own Employment Practices
rfp_requirements.description: The applicant agrees it will be bound by the equal opportunity clause with respect to its own employment practices when it participates in federally assisted construction work (excluding non-participating agencies/instrumentalities/subdivisions of State or local government).

rfp_requirements.title: Post Nondiscrimination Notices
rfp_requirements.description: Post in conspicuous places, available to employees and applicants, notices setting forth the provisions of the nondiscrimination clause.

rfp_requirements.title: No Retaliation for Compensation Inquiries/Disclosures
rfp_requirements.description: Do not discharge or discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because they inquired about, discussed, or disclosed the compensation of the employee/applicant or another employee/applicant.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Executive Order 11246
rfp_requirements.description: Comply with all provisions of Executive Order 11246 of September 24, 1965, and of the rules, regulations, and relevant orders of the Secretary of Labor.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Davis-Bacon Act for Construction Contracts over $2,000
rfp_requirements.description: When required by Federal program legislation, all prime construction contracts in excess of $2,000 shall comply with the Davis-Bacon Act (40 U.S.C. 3141-3144, 3146-3148) and requirements of 29 C.F.R. pt. 5.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Copeland Anti-Kickback Act
rfp_requirements.description: Where applicable, comply with the Copeland Anti-Kickback Act (40 U.S.C. 3145) as supplemented by Department of Labor regulations (29 CFR Part 3), including 18 U.S.C. § 874 and 29 C.F.R. pt. 3.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Contract Work Hours and Safety Standards Act
rfp_requirements.description: Where applicable, all contracts in excess of $100,000 involving employment of mechanics or laborers must comply with 40 U.S.C. 3702 and 3704, as supplemented by 29 CFR Part 5.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Clean Air Act standards
rfp_requirements.description: For contracts exceeding $150,000, comply with all applicable standards, orders or regulations issued pursuant to the Clean Air Act.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Federal Water Pollution Control Act
rfp_requirements.description: Comply with all applicable standards, orders or regulations issued pursuant to the Federal Water Pollution Control Act.

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor controls defense; State must approve settlement
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall have control of the defense and settlement of any claim subject to Section A.1, but the State must approve any settlement, with approval not unreasonably withheld.

rfp_requirements.title: IT Services professional standards warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that all Services will be provided in a professional manner consistent with industry standards.

rfp_requirements.title: One-year Hardware operational warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants new machines are guaranteed fully operational for one year from Acceptance; Hardware Acceptance shall occur no later than 60 days after delivery as evidenced by a signed delivery receipt; contractor shall render prompt service without charge regardless of geographic location.

rfp_requirements.title: Trained mechanics respond within 48 hours
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that trained mechanics are regularly employed to make necessary repairs in the territory within a 48-hour period or within the time accepted as industry practice.

rfp_requirements.title: State ownership of State Data
rfp_requirements.description: The State will own all right, title and interest in its State Data related to the services provided by this contract.

rfp_requirements.title: No retention or copying of State data by Contractor
rfp_requirements.description: At no time shall any data or processes belonging to or intended for the use of the State or its officers, agents, or employees be copied, disclosed, or retained by the Contractor or any related party for subsequent use in any capacity not including the State.

rfp_requirements.title: No intentional erasure during suspension
rfp_requirements.description: During any period of suspension, Contractor must not take any action to intentionally erase any State Data.

rfp_requirements.title: Delete all State Data after retention period
rfp_requirements.description: After the retention period, Contractor must, unless legally prohibited, delete all State Data in its systems or possession in accordance with the Secure Data Disposal provisions.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain data 10 business days after term expiration
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must not intentionally erase State Data for 10 business days after the effective date of termination if termination is in accordance with expiration of defined contract term.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain data 30 business days after termination for convenience
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must not intentionally erase State Data for 30 business days after the effective date of termination if termination is for convenience.

rfp_requirements.title: Retain data 60 business days after termination for cause
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must not intentionally erase State Data for 60 business days after the effective date of termination if termination is for cause.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide post-termination assistance
rfp_requirements.description: The State shall be entitled to any post-termination assistance with respect to the services unless a unique data retrieval arrangement has been established as part of the contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide certificates of destruction
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide certificates of destruction to the State.

rfp_requirements.title: State notification and Contractor control of defense
rfp_requirements.description: The State will promptly notify Contractor in writing of the claim or suit and give Contractor control of the defense and settlement of any claim subject to Section A.1; however, the State must approve any settlement (approval not unreasonably withheld), and the State may observe proceedings and conf

rfp_requirements.title: Labor relations manager must meet/confer with Union delegate before suspension/termination
rfp_requirements.description: When Employer determines suspension or termination is warranted, the labor relations manager must meet or confer with the Union delegate to attempt to resolve the proposed discipline.

rfp_requirements.title: Seniority lost upon voluntary termination
rfp_requirements.description: An Employee's seniority shall be lost when he/she terminates voluntarily, except as set forth in Section 2(a).

rfp_requirements.title: Apply bargaining unit seniority for benefit eligibility
rfp_requirements.description: Bargaining unit seniority must be used in computing and determining eligibility for all benefits where length of service is a factor.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide up to 3 paid investigation days for Union reps
rfp_requirements.description: Upon approval of Manager of Labor Relations (not unreasonably withheld), Union representatives shall be given up to 3 work days of paid time to investigate disciplinary charges that may result in suspension or termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Post nondiscrimination notices in conspicuous places
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must post notices provided by the Public Agency Compliance Officer setting forth the nondiscrimination clause in conspicuous places available to employees and applicants.

rfp_requirements.title: Post nondiscrimination notices (construction)
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must post notices from the Public Agency Compliance Officer setting forth the nondiscrimination clause in conspicuous places.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify listed minority and women workers of vacancies
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must notify any minority and women workers who have been listed with it as awaiting available vacancies.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain waiting list of interested women and minority individuals
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain a waiting list of interested women or minority individuals and consider them for employment whenever vacancies occur.

rfp_requirements.title: EO 151 language is supplemental to Exhibit B good faith requirements
rfp_requirements.description: The Executive Order 151 language is in addition to and does not replace good faith efforts requirements for construction contracts required by N.J.A.C. 17:27-3.6, 3.7 and 3.8 (Exhibit B). Contractor must comply with both.

rfp_requirements.title: Recruit through State Job Bank website
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must recruit prospective employees through the State Job bank website managed by the Department of Labor and Workforce Development, available at https://newjersey.usnlx.com/.

rfp_requirements.title: Keep records of recruitment efforts and minority/women hires
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must keep specific records of its efforts, including records of all individuals interviewed and hired, including the specific numbers of minorities and women.

rfp_requirements.title: Actively solicit and provide proof of employment solicitations
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must actively solicit and provide the Division of Purchase and Property with proof of solicitations for employment, including advertisements in general circulation media, professional service publications, and electronic media.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with N.J.A.C. 17:27
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must comply with the requirements set forth at N.J.A.C. 17:27.
